# Culture Dynamics Profile (CDP)

> The Culture Dynamics Profile (CDP) is an organisational culture assessment from Priority Activator Consulting (PAC). It measures whether a culture can deliver the organisation's strategy, shows where the culture will resist, and sets owned, dated actions, then measures whether the culture moved.

CDP runs on PAC's 4D Framework (Diagnose, Design, Develop, Deliver). It describes culture as a mix of four orientations (Engage, Innovate, Perform, Govern) read through nine dimensions.

## Core pages

- [What is CDP?](https://cdp.pac.africa/what-is-cdp): Plain description of the Culture Dynamics Profile.
- [Platform](https://cdp.pac.africa/platform): How the Assess, Diagnose, Decide, Act, Measure cycle works.
- [Methodology](https://cdp.pac.africa/methodology): The 4D Framework and the nine culture dimensions.
- [Solutions](https://cdp.pac.africa/solutions): Where CDP fits, by the question a leader or board is asking.
- [Security](https://cdp.pac.africa/security): How the platform protects an organisation's data.
- [About](https://cdp.pac.africa/about): Priority Activator Consulting.
- [Contact](https://cdp.pac.africa/contact): Book a CDP briefing.
